tip.en: By 0.6 km your HR has jumped from 126 to 131 in a few strides — a sharper cardiac ramp than your recent flat runs. The pace here (~4:42–5:45) is well ahead of your recent 7:27 average, so monitor that HR doesn't drift too high too early.
tip.zh: 到0.6公里时，心率在几步内从126急升至131——比你近期平路跑的心脏唤醒更快。此处配速（约4:42–5:45）远快于近期7:27均速，注意不要过早让心率漂移过高。

title.en: Peak Cardiac Load at the Park Loop Turn

tip.en: HR hits 153 at km 2.2 — the highest of the run and 24 bpm above your session average. The pace at this stretch has been consistently sub-5:10 for over a kilometre; this is the cumulative cost of running 40 seconds per km faster than recent history.
tip.zh: 在2.2公里处心率达到153——全程最高，比本次均值高出24次。这一段持续以低于5:10的配速跑了超过一公里，这是比近期历史快40秒/公里的累积代价。

title.en: First Unplanned Stop Cuts the Flow
title.zh: 首次意外停顿打断节奏

tip.en: Pace goes null and HR drops from 149 to 131 in under 20 seconds — a full stop at km 2.6 lasting roughly a minute. Coming immediately after the HR peak, this looks like a forced recovery rather than a planned rest; note this pattern repeats several more times ahead.
tip.zh: 配速归零，心率在20秒内从149降至131——在2.6公里处完全停止约一分钟。这发生在心率峰值之后，看起来是被迫恢复而非有计划的休息；注意这一模式在后程还会多次重复。

title.zh: 中段大量步行使努力碎片化

tip.en: Between km 3.4 and 3.8 pace sits at 9–13 min/km for nearly 4 minutes and HR drains from 142 down to 99 — almost a complete cardiovascular reset. The subsequent restart at km 3.8 shows HR slowly climbing back through 101–108, confirming this was a genuine walk break rather than a mild shuffle.
tip.zh: 在3.4至3.8公里之间，配速长达近4分钟保持在9–13分钟/公里，心率从142降至99——近乎完全的心血管重置。3.8公里后的重启显示心率缓慢从101爬回108，证实这是真正的步行休息而非轻微慢跑。

title.en: Cleanest Running Passage of the Second Half
title.zh: 下半程最流畅的跑步段

tip.en: From km 4.9 onwards HR climbs smoothly from 105 to 145 over about 90 seconds of honest running, reaching the best sustained effort since the km 2.2 peak. Pace is controlled at 4:06–5:11 and the cardiac response is proportional — this is what efficient aerobic running looks like for you on flat ground.
tip.zh: 从4.9公里开始，心率在约90秒的正式跑步中从105平稳升至145，是2.2公里峰值以来最好的持续努力。配速控制在4:06–5:11，心脏反应成比例——这正是你在平地上高效有氧跑步的样子。

title.en: Repeated Stop Pattern: Stamina or Distraction?
title.zh: 反复停顿：是耐力不足还是注意力分散？

tip.en: A fourth distinct stop cluster appears at km 5.2, with HR falling from 145 to 125 during a 60-second pause, then another at km 5.3 where it stalls at 101 for over 3 minutes. Compare your Sept 20 and Sept 19 runs — continuous 5:33–5:37 pace at HR 138–140 — to understand how much aerobic capacity is available when you stay moving.
tip.zh: 在5.2公里出现第四次明显停顿，60秒内心率从145降至125，随后在5.3公里再次停滞，心率101维持超过3分钟。对比你9月19日、20日以5:33–5:37配速、心率138–140连续跑完全程的表现——你有足够的有氧能力，只要保持移动。
